name: profile-team
description: Curates a cross-project profile of the entities in your world: drains profile-fact markers into entity profiles at ~/.atl/profiles, each grown through a self-describing, versioned interface.

agents.name: profile-curator
agents.description: Drains profile-fact markers into entity profiles under ~/.atl/profiles: detects the entity type, selects or evolves its interface, fills fields, and rebuilds the profile index.

skills.name: profile-drain
skills.description: /profile-drain — folds pending profile-fact queue items into the global person profiles at ~/.atl/profiles via the profile-curator (privacy-gated, source-flagged, schema lazy-filled).

skills.name: profile-backup
skills.description: /profile-backup - push the global profile store (~/.atl/profiles) to a private remote the user supplies, so their accumulated memory survives losing the machine.

skills.name: profile-restore
skills.description: /profile-restore - bring the global profile store back from its private remote onto this machine: create ~/.atl/profiles if missing, attach the remote you supply, fast-forward only.

rules.name: profile-capture
rules.description: The capture reflex: drop profile-fact markers inline when a durable fact about a person the user cares about comes up; atl tick queues them for /profile-drain.

rules.name: store-backup
rules.description: What to do when atl reports the profile store has no remote: raise it with the user and run /profile-backup; never choose the destination or infer that a remote is private.
